order_of_authority: PDF for model optimization and hyperparameters; Section 3 of directives for dataset and hardware boundaries; ResNet-101 templates for code structure, tracking, and evaluation.

batch_norm.note: PyTorch momentum 0.01 is mathematically equivalent to TensorFlow momentum 0.99 (running_mean = 0.99 * running_mean + 0.01 * batch_mean).

train.pipeline: OfficialInceptionCrop -> Bicubic Resize(512, 512) -> RandomHorizontalFlip(0.5) -> ToTensor() -> ImageNet Normalization
train.crop: TF sample_distorted_bounding_box equivalent: up to 10 attempts, area fraction U(0.08, 1.0), coverage >= 0.1, aspect ratio U(0.75, 1.3333) uniform, fallback to center crop min(h,w)*512/544

optimizer.weight_decay_rule: L2 decay of 1e-5 applied strictly to Conv/Linear weights and biases (including classifier bias); BatchNorm weights and biases have weight_decay=0.0.

learning_rate_schedule.rule: Linear scaling from base_lr=0.016 at batch 256: scaled_lr = 0.016 * (4 / 256) = 0.00025.
learning_rate_schedule.decay_style: Staircase exponential decay starting from step 0.

ema.update_scope: All floating-point model state_dict tensors including BatchNorm running_mean and running_var; integer buffers copied.
ema.step_condition: Updated only on successful optimizer steps; skipped if GradScaler detects inf/nan.

hyperparameters.checkpoint_selection: Best EMA validation macro-F1 at threshold 0.5 saved to best_model.pth; last epoch saved to last_checkpoint.pth

dataset_related: 2-output multi-label binary classification with BCEWithLogitsLoss instead of 1000-class Softmax Cross-Entropy.
No label smoothing (not mathematically defined for multi-label binary classification).
512x512 resolution instead of 224x224 (higher resolution preserves small pulmonary lesions).
Evaluation preprocessing uses Bilinear Resize(512, 512) without 0.875 center crop to match ResNet/DenseNet conventions.
Fixed 70-epoch budget instead of ~350 ImageNet epochs.
system_related: Physical batch size 4 due to 6 GB VRAM constraint on RTX 4050 Laptop GPU.
Learning rate linearly scaled to 0.00025 per official rule (0.016 * 4 / 256).
PyTorch 2.14 and timm 1.0.30 runtime with native AMP FP16 autocast.
unverified: RMSpropTF is not bit-identical to TF1.
torchvision init and stochastic-depth scaling are not verified line by line.
The official main.py snapshot may be older than the live repo.
The batch-4 LR comes from the scaling rule, not from an official run.
The crop (0.08 area) can cut small lesions.
TF crop internals come from documented TF op behavior.
Model selection and 70 epochs are project choices.
